cards.title: Sufficient context without a transcript dump
items: Include decision-changing evidence and conditions. Explain what each lookup pointer can answer.
A short relevant original excerpt may avoid repeated summaries and extra questions.

cards.title: Boundaries before sending
items: Keep material unsent when required authority is missing. Local readability is not permission to disclose.
Supply steps 3–4 or a readable path and revision. The delegate cannot prove that no context was omitted.
